def quat_to_axis_angle(quat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    q = quat.astype(np.float64)

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(dataloader):
        if batch_idx >= args.num_batches:
            break

        # Baseline (no pruning)
        with torch.no_grad():
            loss_base, _ = baseline_forward(model.policy, batch)

        batch_seed = args.seed + batch_idx
        for kr in k_ratios:
            model.k_ratio = kr

            with torch.no_grad():
                _, info = model.forward(batch, step=999999)
            pruned_losses[kr].append(info["action_loss"].item())
            if "margin" in info:
                margin_values[kr].append(info["margin"].cpu().numpy())

        if (batch_idx + 1) % 50 == 0:
            elapsed = time_module.time() - t0

    std_baseline = float(np.std(baseline_losses))

            all_margins = np.concatenate(margin_values[kr])
            margin_mean = float(np.mean(all_margins))

            "margin_mean": margin_mean,
            "margin_median": margin_median,
